cases.detail: Verilator 5.052 zero-extends a signed value passed to push_back or insert of a queue whose elements are wider than the value: push_back of an int of -1 into a bit [199:0] or bit [47:0] queue stores 'hffff_ffff zero-extended instead of all ones. IEEE 1800-2023 7.10.2 and 13.5.1 copy the item argument as by assignment, which extends a signed value by its sign (10.7); Verilator sign-extends the same value assigned to an element or a variable, and the standalone source reproduces the difference. xezim 0.11.3 passes the case.
